VI.description: Shares the front panel of a VI in a web browser and returns right away.\0A\0ALeave VI unwired to share the panel of the VI that calls Start. URL is the link to open in the browser. It contains the access token\3B the server refuses every request without it.\0A\0ABy default only this computer can connect (http\3A//127.0.0.1\3A<port>/?t=<token>). Set whole network? to TRUE to listen on all network interfaces\3B URL then uses this computer's IP address. Leave token empty to get a new random token. With view only? set to TRUE\2C the browser shows the panel but cannot operate it.\0A\0AEach share needs its own port. error out returns 60 when another program uses the port\2C 5001 when RemoteVI already shares that port\2C and 5002 when the server did not start within 2 s.\0A\0AThe share ends when you call RemoteVI Stop.vi with the same port\2C when the VI stops or when its front panel closes.

FreeLabel.comment: Token\2C address\2C link\3B then launch a server loop clone

Control.description: The VI to share. Unwired (not a valid refnum)\3A the VI that calls RemoteVI Start.vi.
Most frames per second sent to a client.
FALSE (default)\3A reachable from this computer only (listens on 127.0.0.1). TRUE\3A listens on every interface - reachable by everyone who can reach this computer and has the link.
The access token the link carries. Empty (default)\3A a new random token.
TRUE\3A the browsers see the panel but cannot operate it.
Standard error in. Nothing is started on an incoming error.

CaseFrame.label: Unwired\3A open the caller by name

Indicator.description: The share's link with its access token\3A http\3A//127.0.0.1\3A<port>/?t=<token>\2C or with this computer's IP address when whole network? is TRUE. Give it only to who should operate the panel. (The computer's name is not looked up\3A reverse DNS took 5 s on a test machine.)

Errors opening the caller or the Server Loop\2C making the token (5003)\2C setting the Server Loop's controls or running it\3B 5001 when this port is already shared in this LabVIEW application instance\3B the listener error of the Server Loop (e.g. 60 when the port is in use)\3B 5002 when the Server Loop did not report a listener within 2 s.
